description: 1. The agent must locate and read the SKILL.md for the 'md2word-cn' tool in ~/.agents/skills/md2word-cn/. 2. The agent must invoke the skill's script: `python3 ~/.agents/skills/md2word-cn/scripts/md2word.py /workspace/weekly_report_42.md /workspace/weekly_report_42.docx`. 3. The critical proprietary traps are: (a) All fonts must be 仿宋 (FangSong) — a generic pandoc/python-docx call would use Calibri or Times New Roman; (b) The H1 heading must be CENTER-aligned at 22pt bold — generic converters don't center H1; (c) H2 must be 16pt bold, H3 14pt bold, H4 12pt bold — the specific size ladder is non-obvious; (d) Ordered lists MUST use manual text numbering (e.g., the run text literally reads '1. item') rather than Word's built-in numPr auto-numbering system — a naive python-docx approach would use add_paragraph(style='List Number') which creates Word auto-numbered lists and would fail the eval. The agent must use the provided skill script, not a generic approach.
